title: Kissed by Fire British Zucchini Shepherd's Pie
description: Sweet and savory, this show-stopping British-inspired dish features zucchini in a rich, cheesy filling, perfect for a cozy evening at home.
instructions: In a large pan, saut	3 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add 1 small onion, diced, and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add 2 medium zucchinis, thinly sliced, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Cook for 1 minute, allowing the flavors to meld.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Mix 1 cup of vegan cheddar cheese with 1/2 cup of nutritional yeast. Add 1/4 cup of olive oil and 1/4 cup of chopped fresh parsley. Mix until well combined.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the top of the zucchini mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
While the pie is baking, prepare a simple salad with mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and a light vinaigrette. Serve the salad alongside the pie.
To serve, carefully remove the pie from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes. Slice into wedges and serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
